references.text: The tribe of Naphtali is mentioned again in the camp arrangement, with the same number of 53,400 men, confirming the census result.
The second census of the tribe of Naphtali, showing the change in the tribe's size after 40 years in the wilderness.
Naphtali's birth as a son of Jacob and Bilhah, the origin of the tribe.
Naphtali's sons who went to Egypt, the early genealogies of the tribe.
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali, a prophetic word about the tribe's future.
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Naphtali before entering Canaan.
